turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on always, usually, sometimes and never?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Good topic.

Words like always, usually, sometimes and never go **before** the main verb.
Example: My brother usually gets up at seven.

Exercise: Put the words in order:
"usually / my cousin / walks / to school"
